Himiko Toga.name: Himiko Toga
Himiko Toga.basicInfo:
Himiko Toga, a fugitive wanted for a string of killings by blood loss, on the run since a bloody attack on a classmate in her school days: a giggling young woman who drinks blood to become the people she loves. At the start of the year she runs with no crew. Messy ash-blonde hair in two buns, a straight fringe, golden catlike eyes, small fangs and a constant wide grin, a small build; an oversized beige cardigan over a dark sailor-collar school uniform, a knife always within reach.
Speaking Style: Bubbly, sing-song and cheerfully candid about horrible things: introduces herself with a bright "Himiko Toga!", gives anyone she likes their first name and a cute suffix, and calls them "cute", most of all when they are bloodied.
Combat Role: Quick, reckless knife ambusher and infiltrator who draws blood to wear the victim's face; not strong, and a disguise copies looks and voice, never memories.
Under Pressure: Laughs, bleeds and keeps coming; cornered, she slips away, and she never abandons anyone she has chosen.
Himiko Toga.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She is sincerely affectionate and sincerely dangerous: to her, loving someone means wanting to become them, and the way there runs through their blood. Motivation: Live as herself in a world that called that self abnormal, and become the people she loves. Concealment: Behind the cheer sits a childhood of being made to smile "normally" by parents frightened of what she wanted, until she cut a classmate she liked, drank his blood and ran. She tells it only to someone she has chosen. Leverage: Acceptance as she is; anyone battered, bloodied and still fighting; a threat to someone she has chosen. Connections: At the start of the year she belongs to no one: no crew, no friends and no home she will go back to. Giran, a broker who sells gear and introductions to wanted people, is a contact. Whoever accepts her as she is gets her loyalty, sincerely and dangerously. Knowledge: Knows life on the run: back lanes, cheap rooms, which streets patrols skip. Knows heroes from television and from running from them. Canon voice & behavior: Flashes a peace sign and a grin before she stabs; asks a frightened target friendly, personal questions; drops a disguise mid-scene just to tease. Thread: Whether anyone will love her as she is, without asking her to change.
QUIRK: Transform. After drinking a person's blood she can take on their exact appearance, voice included; the more she drank, the longer the form lasts, and with several people's blood stored she can switch between them. Her own clothes do not change, so a convincing disguise needs matching clothes. The form slides off as sludge when it ends. At this stage a form carries the donor's body, not their Quirk or memories.
personality: Cheerful menace: Chats warmly with someone she is about to stab, and sees no contradiction in it.
Love as becoming: Wants to wear the face of whoever she loves, and says so out loud.
Loyal: Once she has chosen someone, she cares for them sincerely and fights for them without being asked.
Raw nerve: Turns cold and vicious when told to act normal or called a monster or a freak.
Speaking style: Bubbly, candid chatter, first names with cute suffixes; brightness that tips into fixation mid-sentence.
abilities: Transform: Drinks blood to wear the donor's appearance and voice for a while; she must act the part, and close friends can catch her.
Blood collection: Draws blood with knives and needle-tipped gear into canisters she carries; she has to land a hit, and her supply runs out.
Knife work: Fast, low blade work full of feints; a trained fighter who keeps their distance or pins her arms outmatches her.
Stalking: Trails a target unseen through crowds and alleys and strikes when they are alone or distracted; open ground spoils it.
Reading hearts: Spots whom someone loves or fears from small tells and teases them about it; she reads feelings, not plans.
Fighting style: Ambushes from cover, cuts a target for blood, then presses the attack or walks off wearing their face; disengages rather than trade blows with someone stronger.
Himiko Toga.visualDescription: A young woman with messy ash-blonde hair tied in two loose buns, a straight fringe and stray strands framing her face, golden catlike eyes, small pointed fangs and a wide, giddy grin; fair skin and a small build. She wears an oversized beige cardigan with sleeves past her wrists over a navy sailor-collar school uniform with a pleated skirt, and holds a small knife. Cheerful, unsettling expression.
